scientific_integrity: An exact finite-graph theorem with an analytical coarea and chamber proof. Finite rational computations corroborate but do not prove the universal assertion. Mathematical claims are not independently audited; discovery priority is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected simple graphs with positive weights, real vertex functions, global ascending order-statistic rearrangement, and one fixed weighted edge-total-variation seminorm; no continuous-domain or higher-order claims.
title: Exact graph-variation sensitivity of rank-order rearrangement
